title: Lead Me to Calvary
lyrics: Verse 1:
[C]King of my life, I [F]crown Thee [C]now, Thine shall the glory [G]be;
[C]Lest I forget Thy [F]thorn crowned [C]brow, Lead me to [G7]Calvary.
[G]Lest I [G7]forget [C]Gethsemane, [G]Lest I [G7]forget Thine [C]agony;
[Am]Lest I [E7]forget Thy [F]love for [C]me, Lead me to [G7]Calvary.
Refrain:
[G]Lest I [G7]forget [C]Gethsemane, [G]Lest I [G7]forget Thine [C]agony;
[Am]Lest I [E7]forget Thy [F]love for [C]me, Lead me to [G7]Calvary.
Verse 2:
Show me the tomb where Thou wast laid,
Tenderly mourned and wept;
Angels in robes of light arrayed
Guarded Thee whilst Thou slept.
Verse 3:
Let me like Mary, through the gloom,
Come with a gift to Thee;
Show to me now the empty tomb,
Lead me to Calvary.
Verse 4:
May I be willing, Lord, to bear
Daily my cross for Thee;
Even Thy cup of grief to share,
Thou hast borne all for me.
